programmes.d: Lucy and Martin see a mid terrace in need of a complete overhaul in Chatham, Kent; there's a flat in a gothic-style Victorian house in Sydenham, London with delusions of grandeur and a pair of semis with some potential subsidance in Fenham, Newcastle.
Lucy and Martin visit a two bedroom flat in East London, a three bedroom house in Derby and a two bedroom property close to Southampton Airport.

Lucy and Martin travel to Plymouth to see a cottage that with a lot of TLC could become a gold mine; Nottingham offers a run down home with a lot of room for improvement. Finally on to Chatham where this home really does go 'Under the Hammer'.
Martin & Lucy visit a house in Cheshire, a two bed mid terrace in Lancashire and a property in Cornwall.
Martin & Lucy visit a two bedroom mid terrace property in Gorton, Manchester, a flat in East Dulwich, London and a property in Derby.
Martin & Lucy visit a two bed bungalow in Wiltshire, a ground floor flat in Balham, London and a three bed end-of-terrace in Yorkshire.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts see a massive 4 storey building including a sewing workshop in East London and a scruffy one bed flat in Brighton - but is it hiding a secret? In Essex there's a one bed modern flat in very good condition.
Martin & Lucy visit a semi in Telford, Shropshire, a property in Kent and a house in Morden, Surrey.
Martin & Lucy visit a five-bedroomed house in Cornwall, a three-bed detached property in Hampshire and two bungalows in Glasgow.
Martin and Lucy visit a damp property in Devon, a London flat with an exhibit for the antiques road show and a house in Leicester with surprising views out the back.
Martin and Lucy visit a cottage in Cornwall, a bungalow in Staffordshire and a flat in London.
Martin & Lucy visit a property in Cardiff in Wales, a three bedroomed end of terraced property in London, and a three bedroomed terraced house in Manchester.
Martin and Lucy visit a house in Gravesend, Kent that on 1st look appears fine, a Flat in Middlesex and a fabulous Water Tower conversion in Devon first seen 2 years ago.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Cornwall, a cottage in Canterbury and three bedroomed semi detached house in Wales.
Martin & Lucy visit a bungalow in Middlesbrough, a property in London and a house in Bolton.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts visit a great country cottage near Rochester in Kent, a property in Monmouth that could prove that beauty is only skin deep & finally off to the seaside to view a terraced cottage near Newcastle.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in South Wales, a semi detached house in Southampton and a one bedroomed flat in Telford.
Martin & Lucy visit a terraced house in Devon, a house in London and a two bed bungalow in Leeds.
Martin & Lucy visit a cottage in Devon, a ground floor flat in London and a house in Lancashire.
Martin and Lucy view a four-bedroom house in Tyne and Wear, a detached bungalow in Rochester and a house in Plymouth.
Martin & Lucy visit a three bedroom semi in Stoke, a property in Plymouth and a flat in central London.
